entries.org: Quess Corp Limited — deputed to Indus Towers, Gurgaon
entries.title: Executive – Network Operations
entries.description: Monitoring real-time infra alarms for 18,000+ tower sites on the UOC alarm dashboard. Analysing hourly outage data in Excel (VLOOKUP) to find the worst-hit areas so field teams can prioritise restoration, escalating critical incidents such as fires and major DG faults straight to field team heads, and tracking L1/L2/L3 escalations for landlord and site-access outages through to resolution.

entries.title: Velanthe
entries.description: A full-stack e-commerce storefront: filtering, search, cart, wishlist, mock checkout and order history, backed by unit tests. Every order is priced server-side from the catalog so browser-sent prices are ignored, and PostgreSQL row-level security denies direct writes. Guest carts persist in the browser and merge with the saved cart after sign-in. Also fixed a production auth bug that sent confirmation emails to localhost, and added a GitHub Actions keep-alive for the free-tier database.

entries.title: Skillsight
entries.description: A curated link platform for frontend, design and developer resources. It detects X-Frame-Options/CSP refusals server-side so permitted sites open in an in-app viewer and blocked ones fall back to a direct-visit screen, generates thumbnails with headless Playwright stored in Vercel Blob, and gates curation behind a Better Auth admin dashboard with super-admin roles, user management and audit logging.

entries.title: tenantguard
entries.description: An open-source Go CLI (v1.0.0) that proves cross-tenant data leaks: captured queries are re-run under a synthesised row-level-security policy and result sets are diffed. Five commands (triage, infer, verify, capture, audit), including a PostgreSQL wire-protocol proxy that records real test-suite traffic, plus oracle self-checks that fail closed. Validated against coder and zitadel, where it helped fix 2 real defects.

entries.title: GitOps & Observability Platform
entries.description: A Go service on a 3-node KIND cluster via a parameterised Helm chart, with GitHub Actions CI (tests, Trivy vulnerability gating, GHCR publishing) and self-healing Argo CD delivery. Observability through Prometheus RED metrics, Grafana dashboards and Promtail/Loki log collection.
